name: source_truth_rebaseline
description: Re-fetch authoritative main, exact task head, PR base/head and governing repository truth before relying on prior conclusions.

name: mother_reference_reconciliation
description: Discover the Mother Reference set dynamically from Platform_00 and reconcile requirements, decisions and implementation claims without stale document ceilings.

name: root_cause_first
description: Establish the evidenced failure mechanism before implementation; reject symptom-only patches and unsupported assumptions.

name: bounded_implementation
description: Apply the smallest defensible change inside the approved scope with explicit non-goals and no unrelated refactor.

name: migration_safety
description: Protect schema/data migrations with compatibility, rollback, idempotency, tenant isolation and failure-path evidence.

name: security_negative_testing
description: Prove security boundaries with adversarial and negative cases rather than success-path evidence alone.

name: runtime_failure_injection
description: Exercise crash, retry, timeout, durability and partial-failure paths and distinguish runtime evidence from source inference.

name: alert_quality_evidence
description: Evaluate alert evidence quality, telemetry trust, false-alert controls, severity/confidence separation and INCONCLUSIVE behavior.

name: ai_evidence_safety
description: Constrain AI claims and actions to authoritative evidence, deterministic tool boundaries, tenant/data-egress controls and graceful degradation.

name: exact_head_merge_gate
description: Gate review and merge claims on the exact current head, complete required CI/evidence and independent verification; drift invalidates stale evidence.

name: evidence_bundle
description: Package typed SOURCE_FACT, EXECUTION_EVIDENCE, CI_EVIDENCE, INFERENCE and UNVERIFIED claims with reproducible references.

name: post_merge_rebaseline
description: After an authorized merge, re-fetch main and dependent heads, invalidate stale stack assumptions and reconcile downstream work before continuing.

name: distributed_systems
description: Design and change Core/Sensor distributed behavior: queues, backpressure, timeouts, consistency, failover and split-brain avoidance without reopening two-Core P0 designs.

name: sensor_edge
description: Sensor process/runtime mechanics: scheduling, worker pools, leases/fencing, durable spool, uploader/replay, resource lifecycle and Sensor self-observability.

name: ha_dr
description: Exactly-two-Core Active/Standby HA/DR operability, failover evidence and Sensor continue-to-collect behavior without inventing unresolved replication designs.

name: capacity_performance
description: Hot-path capacity, latency, lag, cardinality and resource-budget evidence for Core, Sensor, UI and storage protection.

name: go_runtime
description: Go Sensor/Agent implementation: context/cancellation, bounded concurrency, durable files, and fail-closed ack/offset behavior.

name: java_spring
description: Java 21 / Spring Core implementation: transactions, validation, actuator boundaries, and fail-closed consumers.

name: typescript_react
description: TypeScript/React UI: role-aware operational screens, server-driven state, accessibility and no generic dashboard filler.

name: python_runtime
description: Approved Python use for AI/analytics/NCM workers: isolation, no silent host installs, and catalogue-constrained dependencies.

name: linux_systems
description: Linux OS, systemd, process, disk, and host-path semantics for Core/Sensor/Agent packaging and monitoring targets.

name: snmp_mib
description: SNMP/MIB collection, SNMPv3 security, counter semantics and Device Pack mapping without declaring device-down from SNMP alone.

name: icmp_path
description: ICMP/path reachability, RTT/loss/timeout evidence and path diagnostics as corroboration, not sole identity.

name: flow_telemetry
description: Flow export collection, template/replay/drop counters, cardinality control and Sensor isolation from flow floods.

name: syslog_traps
description: Syslog and SNMP trap ingestion, source attribution, storm control and evidence-quality parsing.

name: device_control_protocols
description: SSH/CLI, NETCONF/YANG and gNMI/gRPC device control/telemetry with credential, timeout and blast-radius constraints.

name: topology_routing
description: Routing/topology discovery, network-service dependencies (DNS/DHCP/NTP/AAA) and provenance/confidence on graph edges.

name: windows_monitoring
description: Windows Agent service, MSI/BAT install, event/perf evidence and privacy-bounded endpoint collection.

name: agent_architecture
description: Endpoint Agent identity, enrollment/mTLS, durable local collection and privacy-bounded operational telemetry.

name: virtualization_storage
description: Virtualization, datastore and storage-target monitoring without turning Platform into DCIM/BMS.

name: kubernetes_monitoring
description: Kubernetes/container target monitoring, workload identity and collector-health separation.

name: cloud_monitoring
description: Cloud-account/target monitoring, OpenTelemetry import boundaries and vendor-ID normalization.

name: postgresql
description: PostgreSQL control-state schema, transactions, tenant isolation and backup/restore of authoritative data.

name: clickhouse
description: ClickHouse historical analytics, insert idempotency, retention and lag without treating CH as control state.

name: kafka
description: Internal Kafka transport, consumer fail-closed ACK/offset, poison parking and lag evidence.

name: replay_idempotency
description: Replay, dedup, late-data and exactly-once-effect evidence across Sensor spool, Kafka and datastores.

name: backup_restore
description: Backup/restore, retention, cardinality and 80% storage-protection behavior including legal-hold limits.

name: api_event_contracts
description: HTTPS/gRPC/REST and Kafka event contracts, compatibility, error codes and correlation IDs.

name: connector_framework
description: Outbound connector framework: auth, rate limit, retry, idempotency, durable outbound and certification.

name: oauth_oidc_clients
description: OAuth/OIDC client integrations, token handling, redirect safety and secret storage.

name: itsm_change_telemetry
description: ITSM/notification/change-telemetry connectors as supporting evidence, not causal proof.

name: threat_modelling
description: Threat-model trust boundaries, privileged actions, Device Packs, AI tools and update channels before implementation.

name: tenant_isolation
description: Server-side tenant isolation, RBAC/resource scope and cross-tenant negative cases.

name: pki_mtls
description: PKI, mTLS enrollment, certificate identity and untrusted-cert rejection.

name: secrets_handling
description: Credential Profiles, connector secrets, CI credentials, redaction and support-bundle safety.

name: remediation_safety
description: Controlled remediation: deterministic actions, maker-checker, blast-radius, rollback and no LLM privileged execution.

name: docker_compose
description: Docker Compose development/test hygiene: named volumes, healthchecks, no destructive prune, reboot-safe local stack.

name: ci_cd
description: GitHub Actions/CI wiring, exact-head evidence, and no test weakening to obtain green.

name: sbom_provenance
description: SBOM, provenance, CVE/licence review and supply-chain evidence before new OSS.

name: install_upgrade
description: deb/rpm/MSI packaging, systemd lifecycle, upgrade/rollback and reboot auto-start evidence.

name: device_pack_authoring
description: Device Pack schema, identification, mappings, versioning, certification/provenance and test-lab semantics.

name: monitoring_work_units
description: Monitoring work-unit placement, Sensor assignment, capacity impact and locality constraints.

name: temporal_operational_graph
description: Temporal operational graph, topology provenance/confidence and relationship history.

name: rca_hypothesis_fusion
description: RCA hypothesis fusion: observed facts, likely cause, confidence, contradictions, missing evidence and INCONCLUSIVE.

name: incident_flight_recorder
description: Incident Flight Recorder and Similar Incident Memory: bounded, tenant-scoped, advisory historical evidence.

name: change_intelligence
description: Change Intelligence: external/provider/change evidence as supporting context with explicit non-causality.

name: customer_value_mttr
description: MTTR/value analytics with cohort methodology, data quality and no fabricated savings percentages.
